_comment: Slack MCP server ctxgit hands to the chat agent (Claude and Codex alike).
Tokens are browser session credentials and belong in this directory's .env
`requires` keeps the server from being offered at all until both resolve, so
a half-configured Slack is absent rather than broken.
Posting is deliberately not enabled. To allow it, add
SLACK_MCP_ADD_MESSAGE_TOOL to env below — `true` for every channel, or a
comma-separated list of channel IDs to limit it.
